entries.4bffdd8fe04f5281: IVY COSMETICS CORPORATION is headquartered in Akasaka, Minato-ku, Tokyo, and its main business is the manufacture and sale of cosmetics and quasi-drugs. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and its business consists of a single segment: the door-to-door sales business. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 100.
entries.4cfb6d64064e71dd: This business develops and manufactures cosmetics, quasi-drugs, beauty supplementary products, cosmetic sundries and other goods and ships them to sales companies nationwide. Sales companies have sales offices and sales staff, and door-to-door sales to consumers are carried out by the sales companies. The company also conducts sales support activities for sales companies, but it has no capital or personnel ties with them. Products are manufactured at the Misato Plant in Misato Town, Kodama District, Saitama Prefecture, and research and development is conducted at the Development Research Laboratory. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,641 million; by product category, skincare was ¥1,899 million, beauty supplementary products ¥342 million, makeup ¥208 million, hair care ¥143 million, cosmetic sundries and other goods ¥29 million, and other cosmetics ¥18 million. As this is a single segment, there is no segment-by-segment disclosure.
entries.4e7a93d58b3a2b04: They include the household multi-functional beauty device "Ivy Beauty Partner," the continuous electrolyzed water generator "Kireion," and health foods, including foods with function claims and foods with nutrient function claims. Products purchased and resold are the main focus. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥342 million.

entries.a7e59d7410291e47: Toward realizing its long-term vision, “Japan’s Skin Is Made by Ivy,” it says it focuses on expanding its door-to-door sales business through building loyal users and developing sales staff. It says it will hold training and events to develop its sales organization, develop products that sales staff can be confident and proud of, and improve the environment so the sales organization can sell more easily, and it will strengthen training mobilization to increase loyal customers and expand the sales organization. With “Normalizing” as its theme of eternal beauty, it says it will promote the development of high-quality, high-function products centered on anti-aging care, and will also build new revenue sources, such as licensing patented technologies acquired at its development laboratory to pharmaceutical companies. At the same time, it says it will undertake a fundamental revision of its sales system, beauty education system and product system over the next five years, and will also promote revenue outside the door-to-door sales business, such as sales overseas.
